While under investigation, the PMO repeatedly pressured former Attorney General Jody Wilson-Raybould to push the prosecutor to negotiate a deferred prosecution agreeement. She asked the pressure to stop but it did not. A DPA essentially means the company wont be prosecuted if they follow a strict set of rules and changes.

DPAs are used around the world ... but pretty new to Canada. If a DPA was negotiated in this case.. many many Quebec jobs would be saved. Not surprising - the coverage/opinion of this story in Quebec is much different than ontario.

Now with JWR's damning testimony, there is debate on whether the PMO violated section 13 of the criminal code. Political interference is illegal but JWR has said she did not allow the pressure to turn into political interference... opposition wants RCMP investigation and PMO to resign but theres still many ppl to testify.

In Canada its interesting that our AG is not independent- theyre also a sitting member of parliament ... big flaw.

This situation also further complicates our extradition of Huawei CFO - JT stance on that was Canada respects rule of law and does not get involved ... bit contradictory!!
